description: A 57-second scripted fly-around of a small grass terrace cut into a hillside by the sea, with an apple tree, an L-shaped wooden fence (with a gate) running up to the tree's trunk, a stone water channel with a glass wall, a rail track, a stone post with torches, a stone column with a furnace on each side, an L-shaped wooden bench, a small wheat bed and a glass window. 0:00-0:11 the tree close up, 0:11-0:13 the fence at the trunk, 0:13-0:21 the channel (from above, then low through its glass wall), 0:21-0:27 the track, 0:27-0:34 around the post, 0:34-0:41 around the column, 0:41-0:46 the bench, 0:46-0:52 the wheat bed, 0:52-0:57 the terrace from above.
